title: How to Change Which Tiles Allow Ship Passability?

posts.author: WikiAdam
posts.body:
Hi, all.
I'm trying to change the passability for the ship and allow it to traverse on more tiles.
I'm using a tileset that offers three levels of "water depth" (i.e., very dark water, lighter water, and even lighter water). But because RPG Maker MZ is hard-coded to only allow the ship to move on specific tiles in A1, the ship will only move on the "dark" and "lighter" water tiles, not the "even lighter" water tiles, if that makes sense. (See screenshot below)
You could make the argument that logically, ships shouldn't be able to traverse very shallow water, but I'm swapping out my ship sprite for a raft, so I'd like it to be able to traverse any water, regardless of the depth.
I'm not aware of any plugins that change this, and I have no idea how I would change the core code to permit ship passability on other A1 tiles. Hoping someone here has tackled this problem before and knows of a solution, or someone who might have an idea on how to go about it.
Thanks in advance for any advice on what to do here!

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: VS Events and Movement Core <Ship Allow Region: x>

posts.author: WikiAdam
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
VS Events and Movement Core <Ship Allow Region: x>
Click to expand...
Aw, nuts. I've used VS Events and Movement Core in the past and really like a lot of what it does, but that plugin creates significant load times on large maps, so it's unfortunately unusable with my current project.
Good to know that at least someone has addressed this in the past, and that apparently there is some way to have regions trigger passability. I'll explore that a bit. Thank you for the suggestion!

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Hiya,
For an alternative plugin, Triacontane has 'VehiclePassable.js' that I think does what you were looking for, in that you can specify regions/terrian the vehicles can/can't pass.
RPGMakerMV/VehiclePassable.js at mz_master · triacontane/RPGMakerMV
RPGツクールMV、MZで動作するプラグインです。. Contribute to triacontane/RPGMakerMV development by creating an account on GitHub.
github.com
A lot of it is in Japanese, but the main parts seem to be in English.
It needs the PluginCommonBase.js plugin too that you should have in your download of MZ by default.
